title: Interactive Slide Dispositions
description: Make all slides interactive by default: every disposition is hoverable, selectable (click + rectangle marquee with crossing/window rules), draggable, resizable, with per-disposition slide-fullscreen toggle. Ephemeral in-session only.
summary: Fixed drag on flow-layout intro dispositions (e.g. title slide). Root cause: registry cached zero-size rects from measuring hidden reveal slides, and ensureRect reused them without re-measure. Now re-measures on slideEpoch, only when section.present, validates min size, measures content box, and uses unified pointer gesture with capture. Added intro flow + positioned drag DOM tests (33 passing).
